title: H47-QC accessible-artifact uniqueness check

comparison.candidate_mask: finite candidate values greater than zero, restricted to hash-pinned sample-template footprint
comparison.prior_support: finite prior values greater than zero, restricted to the same template footprint
comparison.equal_mass: top 5,000 finite positive prior values in footprint; descending value, then ascending row-major pixel index; only rasters with at least 5,000 positive cells
comparison.method: one-time bounded comparison to the 55-repository public GitHub inventory captured in the H47-B audit; all 336 candidate bytes were verified against their inventory Git blob SHA-1

limitations: Inventory scope is exactly the previously captured public GitHub inventory; it excludes private, deleted, unindexed, and inaccessible artifacts.
Git blob integrity proves fetched bytes match the inventory identity, not organizer provenance, scientific novelty, or score attribution.
Equal-mass ranking is based on raster values and positive support; binary masks use row-major tie-breaking.
The result is a bounded reproducibility/uniqueness check only and does not affect the failed promotion gate.
